# Part B: Probability At Least Two Share a Color

With only 3 colors, "at least two share a color" is the complement of "all three different colors."

Total ways: C(16,3) = 560

Ways for one of each color: 5×6×5 = 150

P(all different) = 150/560 = 15/56

P(at least two share) = 1 − 15/56 = **41/56**

(41 is prime, no common factors with 56 — already in lowest terms)

**P ≈ $52.72**

(Check: 52.72×1.25×0.85×1.18×1.25×1.18 ≈ 97.49, matching within rounding)
